thread:
Emma: Heads up 1 SkylineAI sent over the co-marketing bundle (logos, brand guide, hero imagery, and a 2-page case study). Sharing link: https://drive.redwood.com/skylineai-coasset
Carlos: Downloading now. Any constraints in their brand guide we should watch for?
Priya: Quick skim 1 they have strict clearspace and a 'no-drop-shadow' policy on the mark. Also: their brand guide forbids placing their logo smaller than 60px H on any digital tile.
Emma: Good to know. For the marketplace tile we need 1:1 at 1024x1024 and 16:9 hero at 1280x720, right? Also they asked not to use their gradient as a background behind text blocks.
Carlos: Correct on sizes. We'll do two variants: a text-on-left with imagery on right and a full-bleed hero for the listing page.
Priya: Also legal note: SkylineAI requires explicit written approval for any customer quotes that reference their product. Their contract has a co-marketing clause (section 4.2). @LegalBot can you confirm quote usage?
LegalBot: Read: section 4.2 requires a short attribution and pre-approval of quote text. Do not publish any quote that attributes specific metrics to a named SkylineAI customer without a signed release. Placeholder quotes OK with [QUOTE_PLACEHOLDER].
Emma: Understood. We'll use placeholders until SkylineAI provides the signed release. Carlos, can design include a small 'co-authored by Redwood & SkylineAI' lockup? Their guide allows a lockup but mandates 36px buffer and the tag must be in their secondary sans.
Carlos: Yep. I've got the SVGs from the zip. One thing: their files include only a horizontal and stacked mark. For the small marketplace badge we should use the stacked mark (better legibility).
Priya: Accessibility: we need alt text for each tile and the listing hero. design-bot, suggestions?
design-bot: Alt text options (pick one per asset):
```
- Square tile 1024x1024: "Redwood and SkylineAI logos with headline 'Real-time inference for edge fleets'"
- 16:9 hero 1280x720: "SkylineAI and Redwood case study hero image showing regional inference routing"
- Small badge 200x200: "Co-authored solution by SkylineAI and Redwood"
```
Carlos: I'll adopt the first two, tweak to mention 'dedicated GPU pools' on the hero copy. Priya, can you confirm copy?
Priya: Suggested hero headline: "SkylineAI + Redwood 1 real-time edge inference with regional routing" Subhead: "Dedicated GPU pools, local caching, and predictable latency"
Emma: That reads well. LegalBot: ok to use "regional routing" phrasing? Nothing IP-sensitive?
LegalBot: Fine. "Regional routing" is descriptive. Ensure we don't imply exclusivity or joint ownership of any customer data.
Carlos: Small design note 1 skyline's brand guide forbids overlaying text directly on top of their hero imagery unless theres a 60% gradient overlay. We'll add a semi-opaque overlay to comply.
Priya: Also they requested the case study PDF to use their cover art, but we need to add our Redwood badge on the bottom right. They allow that as long as our badge is smaller than theirs. We'll make it 80% their height.
Emma: OK. Next steps: Carlos to produce the three tile variants + one-page case PDF with placeholder quote; Priya to finalize copy; LegalBot to send a quote approval checklist to SkylineAI. Deadline: EOD Friday for internal review, aiming to publish to marketplace next Wednesday pending SkylineAI signoff.
Carlos: On it 1 will upload design exports to the shared drive under /marketplace/skyline by Friday 5pm PT. Filenames: skyline_tile_1024.png, skyline_hero_1280x720.png, skyline_badge_200.png, skyline_case_v1.pdf
Priya: I'll post the final copy in this thread by Thursday so Carlos can typeset.
Emma: Thanks team. One more: SkylineAI asked if we can localize the tile alt text into FR/DE/JP for marketplace localized listings. Do we handle that?
LegalBot: Localization OK. Ensure translations are accurate and non-promotional beyond the agreed copy. Also keep an audit trail of translation approvals.
Carlos: I'll include a placeholder for translations and flag for localization team.
Emma: Great. Tagging @SkylineAI PM in our external review email after internal signoffs. Closing notes: no customer logos other than allowed ones, full-res SVGs used for lockups, and placeholder quotes until release. :white_check_mark:
